answer: Ambient Acoustic Coherence Attestation: each identity binds to a tamper-resistant microphone at a claimed physical vertex. At random nonces, devices return a hash of live ambient audio—gale gusts, tide-driven low-frequency noise—plus hardware attestation. A subset must co-sample the same transient event across claimed sites, proving independent physical placement. A single operator cannot fake many vertices from one location: replay fails nonce/freshness checks, and synthetic streams fail cross-site coherence. Sybil cost scales to N devices, power, siting, and maintenance.
